Are you passionate about turning data into clear, actionable insights? MOL Romania is looking for a Research & Data Analyst in our Retail Marketing department to support smarter marketing decisions through advanced analytics, customer insights, and market research.
If you're ready to move beyond reporting and make an impact through analysis, we’d love to hear from you!
 As a Research & Data Analyst, you will be responsible for the following-
Analyze marketing, loyalty, and category performance data to uncover trends and identify growth opportunities
Provide monthly and quarterly analysis on brand tracking, loyalty performance, and campaign effectiveness
Develop business cases for marketing initiatives, using historical data and clear financial logic
Conduct competitor monitoring and consumer behavior research, turning insights into strategic recommendations
Track and report key KPIs and marketing budget performance
Collaborate with Group and local teams on research studies, data projects, and analytics reporting
Use tools like Power BI, Excel, and statistical software to visualize and communicate findings
Ensure that data insights lead to concrete action plans and support ongoing commercial decisions
 To be successful in the role, you should have- 
Higher education in Marketing, Business, Economics, or a similar field
Minimum 3-4 years of experience in marketing research & data analysis, or commercial analytics is must
Proven expertise in generating reports in Power BI is must, Excel (advanced), and ideally SQL or other analysis tools
Familiarity with research methodologies (qualitative and quantitative), ability to transform complex data into business-relevant insights
Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently
Fluent in English (minimum B2 level)
Driver’s license is a plus
 Why MOL Romania?
Be part of a regional company with real impact and visibility in marketing strategy
Work with cross-functional teams and gain exposure to group-level projects
Bring data to life in a commercial setting where insights drive real decisions
Join a supportive team culture that values precision, autonomy, and growth 
 What is in it for you?
 MOL fosters a collaborative work environment focused on people, customers and you`ll have the chance to work in one of the biggest and most dynamic companies in Romania.
You’ll work in a fast-paced, international environment and you`ll have the opportunity to leave your footprint on supporting business growth.
 Additionally, We Offer-
Great international work environment, supportive team
Business exposure & career opportunities
Our benefits package includes private medical subscription, meal tickets, significant sports subscription discount, Christmas and Easter bonuses, Bookster subscription, loyalty bonus, life events bonuses, MOL Move VIP level, fresh corner coffee, refreshments and fruits on the house, on-site office massage, etc.
 MOL Romania is a subsidiary of MOL Group and one of the leading oil companies in Romania, with a 30-year presence on the local market. It offers a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, including fuel trading, lubricants, petrochemicals, and bitumen. Presently, the company operates 238 service stations across the country, along with two fuel depots in Giurgiu and Tileagd, and an LPG terminal in Tileagd. MOL Romania is headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, the business headquarters in Bucharest, an administrative office in Arad and a team of 258 employees.
MOL Group is an independent and international oil and gas company active in over 40 countries with a dynamic international workforce and a track record of more than 100 years in the industry.
